objectives: Explain what the men of Sodom demanded and why it was wickedness before the law at Sinai.
Describe how Lot was delivered and what the destruction is an example of.
Explain the lesson of Lot's wife and the origin of Moab and Ammon.
takeaways: To know is to lie with (Genesis 24:16); sodomy was already wickedness long before Leviticus 18.
Lot's sons in law took the warning as a joke and perished; while Lot lingered, the Lord was merciful and the angels laid hold on his hand.
Sodom and Gomorrah are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire (Jude 1:7).
Remember Lot's wife: if you find yourself reminiscing after the old life, remember her (Luke 17:28-32).
Lot's daughters bare Moab and Ammon; uncovering the nakedness of thy father is against the law (Leviticus 18:7).
